description: Context7 provides version-specific software library documentation and code examples for AI coding agents and developers. It indexes sources such as code repositories, websites, llms.txt files, OpenAPI specs, and Confluence spaces, then serves filtered documentation snippets and search results.
summary: Context7 exposes a REST API at `https://context7.com/api` (with OpenAPI at `https://context7.com/openapi.json`), a public unauthenticated Docs7 browser analytics HTTP endpoint, a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.context7.com/mcp`, and the `ctx7` CLI.
